author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Copilot Cowork is now Generally Available. But, there are still questions about subscriptions and usage-based billing. Is Claude Cowork a better option? In this week’s podcast, Kevin, Nick and Jess discuss the new updates to Copilot, including the release of Cowork. Plus, perspectives on Apple’s new Parental Control features, and more AI news.

Hosts: Kevin Stratvert,  Nick Brazzi, Jess Stratton
title: 02 – Copilot Cowork and Apple’s Parental Controls

author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Granola is an AI notepad for people in back-to-back meetings — not another meeting bot. ⭐ To get started with Granola, you can go to granola.ai and use the code STRATVERT to get your first month free!

You jot down the things that matter, and Granola transcribes in the background. When the meeting ends, it turns your rough notes into clear, useful, AI-enhanced notes. Using the Granola Connector in Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI assistants, you can bring all of your meeting information into powerful AI workflows.

Granola can record meeting transcripts from any meeting platform, including Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams. In this video, I’ll show you how to connect Granola to Claude or ChatGPT, so you can do detailed analysis, generate reports or proposals, or model troubleshooting scenarios. 

With MCP connectors, your Granola meeting information becomes a key part of the foundation of knowledge sources in your AI assistant. You can perform data analysis based on your Granola meet
title: Your Meetings in Claude & ChatGPT: Granola Connectors
